why: Both analyses land on essentially the same mailroom-relationship hedgehog with profit per customer, the same exit from point-of-sale and head-on copiers, and the same brutal facts, with comparable flagging of assumptions and missing data. Analysis 2 alone names the long-run risk that business communication moves off physical mail, which is the key's decline mechanism, while Analysis 1 has the slightly crisper headline verdict with an explicit confidence statement.
